lines.t: Here's a math trick banks don't teach you. It tells you how fast your money doubles… in two seconds.
lines.title: THE *RULE OF 72*

lines.t: Take seventy-two. Divide it by your yearly return. That's how many years it takes to double your money.
lines.title: 72 ÷ RETURN = *YEARS*

lines.t: At eight percent a year, seventy-two divided by eight is nine. Your money doubles in about nine years.
lines.label: At 8% per year
lines.title: TO *DOUBLE*

lines.t: At four percent, it takes eighteen years. At twelve percent, just six.
lines.title: YEARS TO *DOUBLE*

lines.t: But it works backwards too. A credit card at twenty-two percent doubles your debt in about three years.
lines.label: Debt at 22% interest
lines.title: YOUR DEBT *DOUBLES*

lines.t: So make the rule of seventy-two work for you… not against you. Follow for more money math.
lines.title: MAKE IT WORK *FOR YOU*
